heading: EXT. FROZEN ORCHARD OF GLASS APPLES - DUSK

units.text: EXT. FROZEN ORCHARD OF GLASS APPLES - DUSK
A hillside of trees that grew crystal fruit and never stopped.
Every apple holds a small captured flame.
The snow around them glows amber.
WILHELMINA THRALE (70s, thick gray cloak, a ladder strapped to her back) climbs to the highest branch.
She plucks one apple, careful as a surgeon, and drops it into her satchel.
It does not clink.
It purrs.
Below her, a boy waits.
FINN CARRAWAY (11, bare ears, no gloves) holds the base of the ladder.
You've not eaten.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: I'm fine.
units.name: FINN

units.text: There's bread in my left pocket.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: Finn doesn't reach for it.
Instead, he stares at the apples, his breath fogging.
They're getting dimmer.
units.name: FINN

units.text: They do, in winter.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: Mam says they were bright all year, when Da was alive.
units.name: FINN

units.text: Wilhelmina lowers herself rung by rung.
At the bottom she stands quietly beside him, close enough that her cloak brushes his shoulder.
Your Da climbed this ladder every night.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: Finn picks at a thread on his sleeve.
Did he ever fall?
units.name: FINN

units.text: Twice. Never told your mother.
units.name: WILHELMINA

units.text: Finn almost smiles.
He takes the bread from her pocket without asking and breaks it in two, offering her the bigger half.
She takes the smaller.
He pretends not to notice.
An apple above them flares, bright as noon, then settles into a soft glow.
They both look up.
Was that him?
units.name: FINN

units.text: Wilhelmina folds the cloak tighter around the boy's shoulders.
She says nothing.
She keeps her hand there.
